title: Sesame Harvest Price Spike
description: Exporters from Kano and Lagos arrive in Hadejia with cash-loaded trucks, triggering a 40% surge in raw sesame grain prices.

choiceA.text: Liquidate stored bags immediately to lock in cash profits
choiceA.consequence: You pocket a substantial profit immediately.

choiceB.text: Hold inventory and negotiate with international consortium
choiceB.consequence: Prices fluctuate, but commercial elders respect your trade nerve.

title: Wedding Fatiha Contribution
description: An influential community elder invites you to a prominent wedding fatiha ceremony at Dutse Central Mosque.

choiceA.text: Donate generous cash gift (₦35,000) & present traditional fabric
choiceA.consequence: Your generosity is announced to applause; your Mutunci reaches new heights.

choiceB.text: Offer humble prayer, modest gift of ₦5,000, and assist with logistics
choiceB.consequence: You protect your savings while fulfilling minimal social obligations.

title: Harmattan Dust Storm
description: A biting Saharan haze engulfs the state. The sun turns silver-white and powdery dust stings the eyes and throat.

choiceA.text: Stay indoors, purchase hot ginger tea (shayi) & rest
choiceA.consequence: You preserve your stamina and breathe easy.

choiceB.text: Wrap turban tightly and keep hustling through the dry haze
choiceB.consequence: You earn extra as others hide, but the dry dust takes a toll on your respiratory health.

title: Kazaure Innovation Hub Micro-Grant
description: The Innovation Institute in Kazaure announces a prototype grant for automated agro-irrigation and solar projects.

choiceA.text: Spend 40 Energy drafting a detailed irrigation tech proposal
choiceA.consequence: Your proposal is shortlisted! You win the initial phase grant stipend.

choiceB.text: Pass on the paperwork and focus on immediate daily business
choiceB.consequence: You keep your stamina intact, but miss out on grant funding.

title: POS Terminal Network Failure
description: A Friday afternoon telecom blackout strikes campus gates right as students line up for weekend cash transfers.

choiceA.text: Switch to costly satellite backup sim and charge slight convenience fee
choiceA.consequence: You save the day for desperate students and rake in brisk commission.

choiceB.text: Power down machine politely and share cold water sachets with stranded folks
choiceB.consequence: Zero money earned, but your empathy wins deep student loyalty.

title: Sallah Durbar Regal Preparation
description: Ringim and Dutse Emirates commence preparations for Hawan Daushe. The town is alive with Kakaki trumpets and caparisoned horses.

choiceA.text: Sponsor embroidered saddlecloths for family royal horsemen
choiceA.consequence: Crowds chant your praise as the horsemen gallop past the palace gates.

choiceB.text: Set up a street concession selling chilled Hibiscus (Zobo) and Massa
choiceB.consequence: You make massive festival sales catering to tourist spectators.

title: Fura da Nono Street Blessing
description: You stop by an authentic milk vendor for a bowl of freshly mashed fura and cool curd milk.

choiceA.text: Enjoy a royal double serving with crushed ice and ginger (₦1,500)
choiceA.consequence: Invigorating refreshment! Your energy and vitality soar.

choiceB.text: Buy a single bowl and pay for the weary traveller sitting next to you
choiceB.consequence: The traveller prays heartfelt blessings upon your endeavors.
